name: brute
note: IDLE COMES FROM THE WALK CLIP. The E idle generation died to a RAM-guard strike and its job dir is empty; the walk's near-zero-lean frames (00385 +0.030, 00387 -0.016) are the pass pose, which is what standing looks like — the same substitution prep-brute.mjs made deliberately on 08-06. Walk alternates +0.129 / +0.030 / -0.100 / -0.006. Attack is a progressive lunge (lean 0 -> -0.278) at constant height, so the narrowing bbox is the arm tucking in, not the figure receding. STUMBLE STOPS AT FRAME 8: from 00633 on the figure is 305px tall against 566 standing — the model dropped it into a crouch and kept it there, which is a death, not a stagger, and at one scale for the whole sheet it would read as the brute shrinking. The three kept frames compress 562 -> 555 -> 531, a body absorbing a hit.
